title: 'One-in-2,000-year weather' to be investigated post-blackout
paragraphs: ElectraNet's contention that "one-in-2,000-year weather" was the likely cause of the Eyre Peninsula blackout will form part of investigations into the incident, the SA government says.
Electricity supply to the peninsula and the state's West Coast was cut on Thursday afternoon when two transmission towers collapsed and a third was severely damaged during intense storms.
ElectraNet says it is conducting a "complete and thorough review" into the power outage.
